name: resource-local-wifi-bulk
description: Sequential maximum-size resource transfers through a shaped pipe at a local-WiFi wire: 25 Mbps with 3 ms one-way latency. This is the high-speed bulk-resource canary: one large sealed stream sliced into parts, pulled by the receiver inside its AIMD window, and hash-proved whole before the next resource starts.
conformance: settled == received with byte-identical totals and zero failures; the pipe delays, it never drops
